notes.title: Flipon 1.5.0 - the return of the blocks
notes.content:
Holidays are for making new content and new features for Flipon, right?
So that's what I did!

[h1]A new planet [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019501/220d744824daeb06ac85129f657c9b7aafc41123.png[/img]

20 new levels with a focus on [b]move-limited puzzles[/b]. There is no story and those levels are probably easier than the previous bonus planet, because I wanted something that everyone could enjoy.
Also, you can play those levels if you did not finish the previous bonus world. You still need to complete the story first.

[h1]Scores in Versus[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019501/4cf4da51742f44f360c0bec73974b5f0dd9a0a64.png[/img]

We're now counting scores in Versus during a session! Show your competitive side and fight with your friends in epic block duels.
Also coming back the menu will not clear the character/devices/power/etc configuration, so you can jsut change a setting or two and start a new game as quickly as possible.

[h1]Level Editor[/h1]

[b]Note: this is a PC only feature[/b]

You can now create levels for Flipon! You can recreate almost any level of the game, except fights for now.
The web-based level editor doesn't require anything to install:
- The editor: [url=https://levels.flipon.net/readme]https://levels.flipon.net/[/url]
- The manual: [url=https://levels.flipon.net/readme]https://levels.flipon.net/readme[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019501/6a04f3e2c22e93afd0fb1e4dc8d753a4b0f2cb41.png[/img]

The best way to share your levels for now is to join the [url=https://discord.gg/7jFZ2fC]official Discord server[/url]. A steam workshop integration may come later if there's enough content for it.

The levels are simple JSON files you need to place in the [b]<game installation>/StreamingAssets/Levels[/b].

A new menu is available in the game ("Your levels"). It will show you what it found in that folder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019501/b16388579c5d3bc950ab68b79e2f23251aa97bd1.png[/img]

From here you can start any level. 


Have fun with those new features!
Cheers!

Damien

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 - Time attack + Versus customization + Challenges v2 + Mobile
notes.content:
[h1][b]Happy new flipoyear![/b][/h1]

Let's begin 2021 with some good things:

- a [b]major update[/b] for Flipon!
- a [b]mobile versio[/b]n for iOS and Android available on the stores today!

[h1]The 1.4.0 patch[/h1]

Listening to your feedbacks, I tried to add some of the most requested features, aside from online multiplayer.
If you want to send me ideas and bug reports, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/7jFZ2fC]Discord[/url] or leave a message on the Steam board!

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]

- [b]Time attack[/b] : new score attack variant! 

Scoring with time limit. 90 seconds or 180 seconds. Selectable from the Score attack menu. 
Each one has a dedicated leaderboard.

- [b]Challenges[/b] : 

Select difficulty: 0 for super easy to 10 for hard

Launch a challenge, difficulty will progress (+1) every 2 successful challenges.

[img]https://www.flipon.net/static/images/Challenges.gif[/img]

- [b]Versus[/b] : you can now customize your games and play for objectives instead of only survival!

[img]https://www.flipon.net/static/images/Versus.gif[/img]

- New [b]settings[/b] : controls remapping v0

[h2]BUGS/LIMITATIONS[/h2]

Controls remaping: 

- it does not update the sprites on the buttons in the menu, [u][b]yet[/b][/u] 
- same controls for everyone in multiplayer
- controls you set will be used in menus too
- ESC, RETURN and TAB are not usable

[h1]Flipon in your pocket[/h1]

You can now play the game anywhere with the mobile versions! 
Guaranteed with an adapted portrait UI and sweet touch controls.
Note that the Steam version slightly differs (bigger grids, bonus levels, multiplayer with more than 2 players).

Grab it here:
- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flipon/id1535461342
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pid.flipon


Have fun and thanks for playing!

Damien
